No, that is not accurate. In Switzerland, there is no requirement for an L-permit (a temporary work permit) for short-term assignments of two weeks or less, even if the work is only for a few days once a year. The L-permit is typically required for longer-term employment arrangements.

However, it's important to note that visa and work permit requirements can vary depending on your nationality and the specific circumstances of your work in Switzerland. It's always best to consult the official Swiss authorities or a qualified immigration lawyer to get the most accurate and up-to-date information for your specific situation.
